description: Full documentation for ONE key — prefer docs([...]) to fetch everything you need in a single round; use this only for a single follow-up lookup. Accepts full ("v1.part.box") or bare ("box") names — ambiguous bare names list the candidates. Also serves whole documents ("DATA", "api/part", "recipes/parametric-part"). Same size cap and paging as docs: a large document answers with page 1 and names the next page ("api/part#2").

method.description: Method name ("v1.part.box", "box"), topic doc ("DATA") or recipe ("recipes/constrained-sketching", "recipes/parametric-part").
